title: Exact Public Class Group Projection
objective: Extend context-owned sealed public class-group repeat projections to exact direct-Minkowski and cubic results while preserving ordinary first-publication verification, detached replay, transactional isolation, and measured zero-repeat algebra

oracles: Ordinary independently verified IdealClassGroup adapter and byte-equivalent conditional/unconditional proof payloads

handoff.summary: Frozen implementation 40318f39d95e4818748a39adf0d08c87afde68ee extends context-owned sealed repeat projections to exact direct-Minkowski and cubic class groups for 3.1.588.1, 3.1.5448.1, and 3.1.4027.2 with proof=False/True. The first publication uses a closure-bound ordinary adapter and exact verifier, then seals the same local result through closure-bound projection type, initializer, allocator, and proof encoder; seven authority fields are checked before and after proof serialization and after sealing. Repeats return fresh immutable view capsules, preserve exact proof-payload parity, and perform zero discrete logs, representative reconstructions, principal-ideal builds, witness verification, and proof-record rebuilds. Six repeat medians are 9.757-10.783ms; class_unit_group ratios are 0.964-1.025x and first-publication ratios are 0.747-0.893x versus exact e7ab7c9d. A stabilized 1,000-view ownership run measured 2,977 RSS bytes and 10,518 heap bytes per retained view; after release and 1,000 discarded views RSS fell below the plateau and heap was only 133,608 bytes above the released checkpoint. Explicit verify remains full and measured 7.134s. Independent exact-SHA re-review returned SAFE after a fresh isolated focused pass in 364.3s; the local strengthened six-row focused pass took 246.85s, strict reported zero errors across 221 modules, and the recorded full native suite passed in 880.14s.
risks: Repository-wide status still lists inherited stale overlaps from older active class-group contracts; this lane starts at reviewed e7ab7c9d with a new exact claim set, passes its own contract, and does not edit those old contracts.

The measured number-field-global-arithmetic package is 1,573,524 bytes against a 1,565,000-byte budget. Independent exact-SHA review is SAFE and the integration lane authorized a ratchet to 1,580,000; this lane leaves the shared package manifest untouched, so pnpm architecture:check remains integration-pending rather than weakened locally.
next_steps: Have the integration lane apply the authorized 1,580,000-byte package-budget ratchet, record pnpm architecture:check, and move the contract to review.
